in_hebrew.name: Allerus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Allerus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'allos', meaning other or different. In Christian tradition, this name represents a connection to the otherworldly realm, often associated with saints and angels.
